episode_row: live predict used each team's own pitcher as opponent after games started

commits.subject: fix: invert target_half logic for opposing pitcher lookup
commits.body:
Away batters face the opposing pitcher in the TOP of innings, not bottom.
Home batters face the opposing pitcher in the BOTTOM, not top.
The logic was backwards, assigning each team's OWN pitcher as the opponent.

Pre-existing bug surfaced when games have partial play data (just started).
